## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

List the commands and manual checks you ran.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated edits.
- [ ] Documentation reflects any user-visible behavior change.
- [ ] Shell scripts pass `sh -n` and ShellCheck when available.
- [ ] No credentials, raw DNS data, client identifiers, private addresses, internal hostnames, reports, or backups are included.
- [ ] Mutation paths include a dry run, verification, and targeted rollback.
- [ ] Email and policy changes remain opt-in and human-approved.
